```

This query will return the lowest non-null value of the "Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" column from the "frpm" table.

SELECT 
    `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
LIMIT 3;

SELECT MIN(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS LowestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
LIMIT 3;

SELECT MIN(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS LowestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation' AND `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT TOP 3 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)]
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    schools.StatusType LIKE '%Continuation%'
ORDER BY 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)] ASC;
